items.title: Demashita! Powerpuff Girls Z - Full Series (Japanese Dub)
items.description:
I realized that the English dub of this series was available on the Internet Archive, but the Japanese dub English subbed version was not. I am uploading this now to fix that. 

Here is a link to the English version on this site: https://archive.org/details/powerpuff-girls-z-comp
